name: St John Horsfall
features: fair skin, dark hair combed back, pale eyes, long bony face, thin lips, tall lean build, unflappable quiet expression
bio: ‘Jock’ Horsfall, the Aston Martin driver against whom other Aston Martin drivers were measured. He won the 1938 Leinster Trophy and the 1946 Belgian Sports Car Grand Prix, and in 1949 drove the entire 24 hours at Spa single-handed to finish fourth. In the war he drove for the secret service and carried the body used in Operation Mincemeat on the first leg of its journey. He was killed at Silverstone in 1949.
